exchanges: finally got the laptop open. sara wanted me to read the same book four times
Four times is commitment. Which book was it?
the one about the hungry caterpillar obviously
A classic for a reason.
my wife Hana took emil to swimming so its just me and sara and a pile of reports
How old is Sara now?
two and a half. shes napping now thank god
Perfect timing to get some work done.
yeah. my wrist is killing me though, doc says its tendonitis from too much mouse
That sounds painful. Did they suggest anything?
a brace and ice. and less mouse which lol
Hard advice to follow at a desk job.
emils swim coach is called leon, same as my cousin leon, emil thinks thats hilarious
Kids love a coincidence like that.
coach leon is from Glasgow and emil has started copying his accent
That must be funny to hear from a five year old.
my cousin leon is from Marseille so emil thinks every leon has a funny accent
Two Leons, two very different accents.
haha yeah
Is your cousin close by?
no he still lives over there. we see him every couple years
That makes visits feel special.
speaking of trips, we booked our summer holiday last night, Reykjavik!! hana has wanted to go forever
Exciting. Are you taking the kids?
yes god help us
They might love it. Lots of waterfalls.
my mother in law ingrid is coming too which is great, extra hands
An extra pair of hands on a trip is gold.
she only talks to the kids in Norwegian so they pick it up, emil can already count to ten
That is a wonderful gift for them.
lunch break. pierogi from the freezer, old family recipe, honestly my favourite food on earth
Nothing beats a family recipe.
hana makes fun of me, she'd pick sushi over anything
Everyone has their comfort food.
true
How is the wrist holding up today?
meh. oh hold on i got the trip wrong, hana just texted me, we switched it to Copenhagen because the flights were half the price
Good to know. Still an exciting trip.
yeah still excited. emils birthday party is the next big thing anyway
When is it?
three weeks. we booked Jumpzone, the trampoline place, 15 kids, i might die
Fifteen kids on trampolines is a brave choice.
my buddy bilal said hed come help, him and his wife Noor are saints
Good friends to have.
they really are
Do they have kids too?
not yet, maybe one day
There is plenty of time.
sara's awake. that was a short nap
Short naps are the cruellest.
bilal just pulled up outside in his new Prius to drop off the folding tables
Perfect timing, good of him to bring them.
wait where did coach leon grow up again
ok tables are in the garage, bilal says hi
Say hi back.

earlier_question.right_reply: Coach Leon is from Glasgow, which explains the accent Emil keeps copying.
